text: レッドは　しょくぶつポケモン　フシギダネが　いいんじゃな？

structure.jp: しょくぶつポケモン　フシギダネが

structure.en: is the one you want, right?

patterns.name: 〜がいい
patterns.span: フシギダネが　いい
patterns.explanation: A thing followed by がいい says that this is the one you pick or want. フシギダネがいい = 'Bulbasaur is the one I want'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ gives the feeling of checking or explaining how things are. Here it is んじゃ, the old-man form. いいんじゃ = 'so it is that you want it'.

patterns.name: 〜な (confirmation)
patterns.explanation: な at the end asks the listener to agree, like ね but in an older man's voice. いいんじゃな = 'that's the one you want, right?'
